period_note: Recovered via a Wayback Machine capture of DSE's OWN company page (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK), NOT the bank's site. From this vintage onward DSE no longer publishes Turnover/Revenue or Profit-in-BDT on this page (the rows are present in the page's HTML but wrapped in a comment, rendering only placeholder zeros) -- only EPS and period-end market price remain, matching the identical presentation change already documented for RUPALIBANK from its own 2023 capture onward. Sourced from DSE's (dsebd.org) own company-page interim table, NOT the bank's own site (pubalibangla.com, Cloudflare-blocked). Solo/Standalone basis presumed, consistent with this bank's established series basis, but not explicitly labeled solo vs consolidated on the DSE page itself -- flagged as an assumption, not a confirmed fact (same caveat documented for RUPALIBANK's use of this identical source type). FLAG: Q1 (1.740) + Q2 (2.190) = 3.930, vs the reported Half-Yearly cumulative of 3.730 (a 0.20 BDT/share gap, not DSE-tooltip-flagged). This is consistent with a discovered pattern in this bank's series: the 05-06-2024 AGM (for FY2023) fell between Q1 and Q2 2024, and share count rose from a smaller pre-AGM count to 1,156,830,995 by the time of this capture -- when the AGM declares a bonus/stock dividend, Q1's EPS (filed pre-AGM) and Q2/HY's EPS (filed post-AGM) are apparently computed on different share-count bases without a retroactive Q1 restatement (same mechanism identified for 2011 and 2014 -- see insights.json). Recorded as reported, not silently reconciled.
